web-view

Container that hosts web pages. It automatically spreads the entire Mini Program page.

Attribute Type Default value Mandatory or Not Description
src String No webview link to a web page
header String No Additional header information required to access the page, both key and value are Strings
loadingStyle String 'default' No The loading style during page loading has two options: default and loadingWithLogo. All other invalid inputs will display the default style. (Minimum version: 25.12.0)

Sample Code

<web-view src="https://example.com/" header="{ 'key': 'value' }" loadingStyle="loadingWithLogo"></web-view>
